Today I’m going to show you how to make homemade Hot Honey Chicken completely from scratch. This recipe combines perfectly seasoned, golden crispy chicken with a rich, buttery hot honey glaze that coats every piece perfectly. Follow along as I show you step by step how to prepare the chicken, create an ultra-crispy coating, and make the perfect sweet and spicy hot honey sauce. I guarantee you’re going to love this recipe. Enjoy!
